answer: Every gate that trusts the applicant fails the same way, so this gate trusts the archive instead. Podiatrist registration with health council attestation builds the archive from four-year degree, 500 supervised treatments, board exam, annual fees. The inlet is reuse: the evidence already exists, created for work, tax, or licensing years ago, and the applicant merely points at it. Rebuilding it from nothing means recreating every piece, and the voyage in each piece is a clerk or registrar holding an independent copy. The summit is the comparison — the copies agree, or the applicant walks away.
